sights.n: Sugar Loaf Hill (シュガーローフ / 安里52高地)
sights.w: The low hill the US Marines called Sugar Loaf and the Japanese 'Asato Hill 52', locally Kerama-chiiji, was fought over by the 6th Marine Division and the Japanese 32nd Army in May 1945. Today it is the Asato reservoir park beside Omoromachi monorail station, with an inscribed marker amid the new city centre.
sights.k: Battle of Okinawa hill in the middle of Shintoshin

sights.n: Great Akagi Trees of Shuri Kinjō (首里金城の大アカギ)
sights.w: A grove of six huge akagi (Bischofia) trees and one Ryūkyū hackberry behind the Uchikanagusuku shrine just off the Kinjō-chō stone road, designated a national Natural Monument in 1972; the largest is 5.2 m round and 13 m tall. No other such grove of giant akagi survives in a settled area of Okinawa.
sights.k: National Natural Monument grove off the stone road
